cards.text: Paul, an apostle, writes a letter to the churches of Galatia, along with all the brothers who are with him. Most folks open a letter with 'Hope you're well.' Paul opens by telling them who sent him, like a man flashing his BADGE at the door.

cards.question: Paul says he wasn't sent from men or by any man. So who does he say sent him as an apostle?

answers.text: Jesus Christ and God the Father

cards.question: In his opening line, Paul describes God the Father as the One who raised Jesus from the dead.

cards.text: Now the hello: grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. And right away, Paul tells what Jesus did: He gave Himself for our sins.

cards.question: Paul says Jesus gave Himself for our sins to ___ us from the present evil age.
Paul says Jesus gave Himself for our sins against the will of God the Father.

cards.text: Paul even stops for praise: "to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen." Then the warm fuzzies are OVER: Paul is amazed, and friend, NOT the good kind of amazed.

cards.question: What does Paul say amazes him about the churches of Galatia?

answers.text: How slowly their churches are growing
How rarely they've written to him

cards.question: The Galatians are deserting the One who called them by the grace of Christ. What does Paul say they're turning to?
Paul says the different gospel the Galatians are turning to is still a real gospel, just another version of the good news.

cards.text: So where's all this coming from? Paul doesn't name a single name, just some people who are troubling them, and I bet he's tapping his foot the WHOLE time he writes it.

cards.question: Paul says the people troubling the Galatians are trying to ___ the gospel of Christ.

cards.text: Now Paul gets serious about any gospel contrary to the one "we preached to you" and he doesn't leave himself out of the warning. Then he adds somebody you would NEVER expect.

cards.question: Paul's warning covers "we" too: if anyone preaches a gospel contrary to the one the Galatians first heard, Paul says let him be under a curse. Who else does Paul name in that warning?

cards.text: Then Paul says, "As we have said before, so now I say again: If anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be under a curse!" Once is a warning; twice is Paul underlining it, circling it and drawing stars all around it.
Then Paul turns the questions on himself and asks whose approval he's really after. I bet nobody in Galatia expected a pop QUIZ in the middle of a letter.

cards.question: Paul says that if he were still trying to please ___, he would not be a servant of ___.
